name: Semiconductor Processing Co
old_description: Semiconductor Processing Co. (SPC) shall continue in operation at its present facility in Boston, through 12/31/2012.
about:
Semiconductor Processing Co. (SPC) has operated from Boston, Massachusetts since its founding in 1967. The company, known for precision wafer manufacturing, maintains its facility at 12 Channel Street in the city's Seaport district.

SPC specializes in silicon-on-insulator (SOI) and germanium-on-insulator (GeOI) wafer production, offering substrate bonding services and 200 mm processing capability. Its equipment roster includes a production bonder for SOI and direct wafer bonding, a scanning acoustic microscope, an MRL dual horizontal tube furnace, and various ADE gauges for metrology. The facility has provided these services continuously since 1967, with a focus on high-precision substrate preparation.

The company serves semiconductor manufacturers and research organizations requiring advanced wafer substrates, though specific customer names are not disclosed. In 2012, SPC announced plans to relocate its Boston operation, with equipment liquidation handled by El-Cat, Inc. The transition aimed to maintain service continuity for clients placing orders for completion within the year.

The firm emphasizes its long-standing expertise in precision wafer manufacturing, dating back to its establishment in 1967, positioning itself as a dedicated source for specialized insulator-based wafer technologies.
